_note: Daily update check-ins (SRS 24): a Slack direct message to each recipient (Bitrix24 user IDs, found in Slack by work e-mail) at 11:30 (who has / has not planned) and 19:00 (who has / has not wrapped up), working days only. channel true also posts the not-planned list to the daily work update group at the plan time, each person mentioned; a plan first posted after the plan time is tagged Late planned.
